comparison: Both evaluate claims C22-C26 about SPG enrichment validation. OpenEval finds the evidence SUPPORTED through multiple validation methods (immunocytochemistry, marker genes, deconvolution). Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, raising critical concerns about THY1+ FACS specificity, noting it recovers somatic cells and questioning the 99% SSC deconvolution results as 'impossible' given PLZF/KIT marker overlap.

OpenEval evaluates C27-C28, C36-C40 as SUPPORTED based on RNA-seq differential expression with appropriate statistics. Peer reviewers evaluate overlapping claims C27-C33, C36-C41 as UNCERTAIN, acknowledging technical quality but questioning novelty, stating bulk RNA-seq 'does not add any novel information' compared to recent scRNA-seq studies and that mixed populations mean results 'do not reflect the biology of any one type of spermatogonium.'

OpenEval finds C30-C31, C41 (GO enrichment analysis) SUPPORTED as biologically coherent with SPG development. Peer reviewers include these claims in their broader UNCERTAIN evaluation of RNA-seq results, citing lack of novelty and mixed cell population issues affecting interpretation.
